section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining associations between Big Five personality traits and body image in 509 men from the community in London, UK. The study measured drive for muscularity and body appreciation, finding that Neuroticism and Extraversion significantly predicted body appreciation after controlling for BMI and subjective social status.
